name: VSData Aragatsotn data center
notes: DCD reported ground broken for a 2MW, 125-rack Tier III-quality facility in a cooler gorge in Aragatsotn, connected to Yerevan by 25km fiber and targeted to go live by end-2025.

name: Yerevan State University AI data center
developer: Yerevan State University / Government of Armenia / Legrand
notes: YSU says the government-funded 64 NVIDIA H100 supercomputer was installed and the data processing center infrastructure was prepared and tested; Legrand later reported delivery of the AI data center infrastructure and inauguration.

name: Viva Data Centers colocation
notes: Viva's official business colocation page states that it offers colocation services at advanced data centers located in Yerevan, with 2N power and cooling, fire suppression, security, and connectivity.

name: Ucom colocation data center
notes: Ucom's official colocation page describes customer equipment installation at Ucom technical nodes/data center, including rack space, power, cooling, security, access, and 24/7 support options.

name: Armenian National Supercomputing Center
developer: Armenian National Supercomputing Center / Enterprise Incubator Foundation / Government of Armenia partners
notes: ANSCC reported the National Supercomputing Center opened at Engineering City on May 31, 2024; the U.S. Commercial Guide places the National Supercomputer Center in Engineering City on the outskirts of Yerevan.

name: AG TEK Yerevan data center
notes: Baxtel lists a planned AG TEK LLC data center on Masis-Jrarat Highway in the Yerevan market, with site planned for 2028 and expansions through 2030; no primary source found in this pass.

name: Eleveight AI Gagarin AI factory
notes: Eleveight says its Gagarin, Gegharkunik facility is Armenia's first commercial-scale NVIDIA Blackwell-powered AI Factory, with first-phase IT power up to 1.5MW and reserved capacity to scale to 40MW; Armenpress reported the opening in Gagarin.

name: OVIO Data Processing Center
notes: OVIO's official page identifies a Tier III data center with 2MW and 216 racks; ARKA reported the government-approved Abovyan/Kotayk project by GNC Alfa and later described OVIO's operational Abovyan facility.

name: Firebird Hrazdan AI Factory
developer: Firebird.ai / Team Group / Government of Armenia partners
notes: Firebird officially launched its Hrazdan AI factory on Aug. 8, 2026 and announced an Armenia roadmap to 300MW and more than 70,000 NVIDIA Rubin/Blackwell GPUs by end-2027; earlier announcements described the site as a 100MW first large-scale AI data center.
